scope: Worker idle backoff and commit signals, batched durable projections, single-statement conditional heartbeat, bounded concurrent renewal and scheduler/MVC executor isolation. Offline/local fixtures and real PostgreSQL containers; no production capacity claim.

maven.verification_method: Full suite followed by focused reruns after two test-only fixture updates; production sources and packaged jar remained unchanged.
maven.full_run_failure: RoleAssemblyIT setup still expected migration V7; actual schema correctly migrated to V8. Other completed tests passed.

followup.finding: Role schedule-count expectations still omitted the newly separated recovery task; replaced with exact per-role scheduled method names and heartbeat-scheduler presence.

maven.heartbeat_fixture_cleanup: Await the released mocked heartbeat before closing its worker; avoids a teardown interruption diagnostic. The 9 worker polling/heartbeat tests were rerun successfully.

source_manifest.format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact sorted JSON mapping each path to its SHA-256; src tree plus pom.xml, compose.yml, Dockerfile, ops/container-entrypoint.sh, scripts/validate-compose.py

idle_worker_and_outbox_per_second.basis: Configured periods and deterministic-clock call-count tests, excludes startup backoff ramp, health/memory scans and SQL/scheduler duration.

projection_50_intents.note: Necessary durable row writes remain; reduction is statement round trips and transaction count.

limitations: Live SSE and immediate queue wakeups are process-local; cross-process queue writes use bounded fallback scans.
Heartbeat scheduling is isolated, but database connections are shared; pool exhaustion and lock delays can still fence expired leases.
Java thread interruption cannot guarantee an already-running JDBC transaction is cancelled.
Offline fixture load and SQL call counts are not production throughput/latency acceptance.
